His wife Heather shared the news of their newborn while Kutryk was on his six-month mission. Although the pregnancy was unplanned, the couple felt well-supported by their community and space agencies. Kutryk hopes his daughter will view his mission as a sacrifice for public service.

articles.title: Private fuel retailers post sales decline in October
articles.description: Private fuel retailers, such as Reliance-BP and Nayara Energy, saw substantial declines in diesel and petrol sales. Higher fuel prices led customers to prefer state-run retail outlets like Indian Oil and Bharat Petroleum. As a result, state-run retailers increased their diesel and petrol sales significantly during October. The increase in demand from bulk customers also impacted the market dynamics in October.

articles.title: ‘Too powerful to release’: Anthropic, OpenAI employees raise alarm over unreleased models

This has intensified calls for stronger governance and protective measures for AI technology, highlighting the need for industry-wide safety standards.

articles.title: Vande Bharat sleeper trains get new flight-style food menu: IRCTC reduces meal weight and options on 3 routes; check what's changing for passengers
articles.description: Vande Bharat Latest News: Indian Railways has launched a pilot project for a new meal service on Vande Bharat sleeper trains. This service features a smaller, flight-style menu designed to enhance food quality and hygiene. The revised catering arrangement includes specific meal options for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Various food service providers have been engaged to prepare and deliver meals across different routes. Meal weights have been reduced, yet the portion sizes remain unchanged.
